## Changes

- Improved indirect IL2CPP call decompilation by avoiding one misleading function prototype for every `Il2CppMethodPointer`.
- Preserved named vtable slots, `VirtualInvokeData`, helper calls, and managed method signatures while reducing avoidable decompiler retries.
- Added importer checks for IL2CPP callback types on both 32-bit and 64-bit programs.
- Restricted release archives to the expected extension files and native library for each platform.
- Required the complete test suite, Clang sanitizers, Valgrind, native verification, and a real Ghidra smoke test before publishing.
